words: The player's bonus budget. Tier 3 gets 3% of their lifetime P&L, Tier V gets 5%. Bonuses are paid out of this balance.
The most a task may pay, as a share of the SW. Grace 20%, Birthday 25% (Tier 3) or 30% (Tier V), LTV 40%, Top P&L 40%.
The total valid bet amount. 1x means the player must bet the credit once before withdrawing.
Giving a player two rewards for the same event or on the same day. Not allowed.
A logged contact must come before the player's (re)deposit. No logged contact first, no credit.
Credits end in 8 (RM 38, RM 118). Take the highest one at or below the cap.
A line above which CS cannot issue alone and the ATL must approve first.
The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Can this credit go ahead?
items: The player is on the task's eligible list
A logged contact came before the (re)deposit
No Reload, Compensation or LTV reward went out to them today
tour.done: All three: carry on to the steps.
tour.notYet: Any "no" means no credit. No contact first, no stacking.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Seven steps, for every bonus
items: Verify
Eligible list, contact before deposit, one count per player per month.
Pick the ladder
Name the task (Grace, LTV, Top P&L, Birthday, Weekend) and its ladder.
Refresh the SW
Update the SW today before any sizing.
Size
Highest amount ending in 8 at or below the task's SW cap. Above the max, use the max.
Check the gate
Over a threshold: ATL. Otherwise CS issues within the cap.
Issue
Set the task's turnover and state the validity.
Record
Player, task, amount, TO, SW deducted or not, who issued, time. File the claim ticket.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Five hard stops
items: Credit a deposit that came before any logged contact.
Size on yesterday's SW, or go above the task's SW cap.
Stack two rewards on the same day.
Pay Top P&L to a player who is profitable this month, even after a loss today.
Hint at a bonus on Telegram.

tour.label: Numbers
tour.title: SW cap and turnover by task
items: Grace Deposit Challenge
SW x 20%, 1x turnover.
Birthday, Tier 3
SW x 25%, 1x turnover (SW base). No SW: deposit base, 3x turnover.
Birthday, Tier V
SW x 30%, 1x turnover (SW base). No SW: deposit base, 3x turnover.
LTV List
SW x 40%, 1x turnover.
Top P&L
SW x 40%, 1x turnover. Monthly P&L must also be negative.
Example
Top P&L, loss RM 10,000 (ladder RM 118), SW RM 250: cap = RM 100. Issue RM 98, the highest ladder row at or below the cap.

tour.label: Approver
tour.title: Who can issue it?
tour.q: Is it a Birthday credit for a lifetime Total Deposit of RM 100,000 or more, the Weekend Deposit Challenge, a system fault (like S0403), or any other exception?
tour.yes: The ATL approves first. CS cannot self-issue an over-gate case.
tour.no: Within the SW cap on the standard ladder: CS issues it directly.

pool.q: A player redeposited at 2 PM. Your first logged contact with them was at 4 PM. Can you give a retention credit?
o: No, contact must come before the deposit
pool.why: Contact precedes deposit. A deposit before any logged contact earns no retention or reactivation credit.

pool.q: You are sizing an LTV bonus and the SW figure is from yesterday. What do you do?
o: Use it, it is close enough
Refresh the SW today, then size
pool.why: A stale SW is not a valid base. Refresh it the same day before sizing.

pool.q: What is the SW cap for the Grace Period Deposit Challenge?
pool.why: Grace is SW x 20%. Birthday is 25% or 30% by tier. LTV and Top P&L are 40%.

pool.q: A player got an LTV reward this morning and now qualifies for Top P&L tonight. What do you do?
pool.why: No stacking. Skip if a same-day Reload, Compensation or LTV reward already went out.

pool.q: A player lost RM 5,000 today but is up RM 2,000 this month. Top P&L bonus?
o: No, monthly P&L must be negative
pool.why: Top P&L needs a negative monthly P&L too. A player who lost today but is profitable this month gets nothing.

pool.q: A confirmed system fault (S0403) needs a goodwill credit. Who approves?
pool.why: A confirmed system fault or any exception goes to the ATL.

pool.q: Birthday credit on the deposit base (no SW). Which turnover?
pool.why: 1x is the default. The Birthday deposit base is the exception: 3x turnover.

pool.q: Top P&L: the player lost RM 10,000 today, which is RM 118 on the ladder. Their SW is RM 250, so SW x 40% = RM 100. What do you issue?
pool.why: Never go above the cap. Take the highest ladder row at or below RM 100: RM 98 (the RM 8,000 row).

pool.q: On Telegram, a player asks if there is a bonus this week. What can you say?
o: No bonus promise or hint at all
pool.why: Telegram never promises, implies or hints at a bonus.
